subject: Mystic Avenue Corridor District Zoning Update
overview: The committee finalized the draft zoning proposal for the Mystic Avenue Corridor District, which includes four new sub-districts and updated development standards. The proposal was referred to the full City Council for formal processing and referral to the Community Development Board.

items.title: Zoning Ordinance Updates (24-033)
items.summary: Referred the Mystic Avenue Corridor District (MACD) zoning proposal to the next regular City Council meeting while retaining the overarching zoning update paper in committee. The committee and consultants reviewed the final draft sub-districts, use regulations, and development incentives, and discussed strategies for future public communication regarding global standards like parking and 'green scores.'
